notes.title: Update Notes for September 24th (v1.0.2)
notes.notes: [p]I'm impressed by many of the highscores that you all have been getting. Thank you for playing![/p][p][/p][p]Here are some minor changes we have made in the latest update:[/p][p][/p][p]Improvements:[/p][p]- When building high up, the camera will now stay in place when starting climbing with space or the start button. Press any of the movement keys to immediately get to Bob.[/p][p]- A smooth camera transition when changing between building to climbing.[/p][p][/p][p]Bugs:[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where going between build and climb hundreds of times in the same level could crash the game.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue with the background music not changing in the sandbox.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Notes for August 28th (v1.0.1)
notes.notes:
Thank you to everybody that has been playing the game and providing valuable feedback!

Here are some minor changes we have made in the latest update:
- Added an option for display resolutions to the settings menu
- Fixed an issue with moving the camera for resolution aspect ratios other than 16:9
- Fixed an issue with leaderboards not loading in some cases
